messages:
alex: deploy-bot scheduled UNPIN SDK v3.1 -> v3.2 for canary at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. FYI to SDK, docs, and support teams.
deploy-bot: Scheduled action: UNPIN sdk v3.1 -> v3.2 (canary). Trigger: sdk-release-window. ETA: 02:00 UTC.
sam: Quick note from SDK QA: v3.2 changes the embeddings API signature (vector metadata arg renamed). Backwards compat adapter was supposed to be in, but I don't see it in the build.
qa-ana: Reproduced locally: hosted-embed tests fail on call `client.embed(text, metadata={})` -> TypeError: unexpected keyword 'metadata'.
qa-ana: Failing stack:
```
TypeError: embed() got an unexpected keyword argument 'metadata'
File "site-packages/redwood_sdk/embeddings.py", line 78, in embed
  payload = _build_payload(text, metadata=metadata)
```

ops-lee: If we roll the SDK unpin without adapter, customer code using metadata will break. Do we know scope?
sam: Telemetry: ~0.4% of embed calls in prod include the metadata kwarg; concentrated in a handful of customers and internal examples.
englead-maya: Proposal: pause the SDK unpin. Two options: (A) fast add compatibility shim in SDK that accepts metadata and maps to new param; (B) delay unpin and release v3.2.1 with shim. Which is faster?
alex: We should prefer shim+canary so we don't block the whole release train. Sam: estimate 40m to implement, test, and CI.
docs-rachel: If we go shim route, I need to update release notes and deprecation blurb. Can we call it out in the SDK changelog and quickstart?
qa-ana: Hogwild local patch works. I can run quick smoke across canary harness once CI artifact is built.
sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/902 - "chore: embed(metadata) compatibility shim for v3.2"
deploy-bot: PAUSE unpin action for thread 2490012345. Reason: compatibility shim pending. (requested by alex)
ops-lee: I'll notify oncall to watch errors and set a temporary kb alert for embed TypeErrors > 0.1% as a guard.
englead-maya: Timeline decision: if PR merged and CI green within 60m, proceed with scoped canary (10% SDK clients) then full unpin. If not, lift hold and schedule unpin for next window after patch.
qa-ana: CI green (2490014200). Artifact: sdk-3.2.1-canary.
alex: Starting scoped canary at 02:12 UTC to 10% of sdk-client traffic (non-blocking embed endpoints only).
deploy-bot: Resuming UNPIN of sdk v3.1 -> v3.2 (scoped canary).
qa-ana: After 20m: embed TypeErrors dropped to zero for canary cohort. Latency unchanged.
docs-rachel: Updated release notes: https://docs.internal.redwood/release-notes/sdk-3-2-1 (added compatibility note and code snippet showing shim).
sam: Recommend proceeding with full unpin. Also flagging support playbook for quick rollback if we see customer issues: https://playbooks.internal/unpin-sdk-rollback
ops-lee: Alerting support leads with a 30m heads-up.
englead-maya: Full unpin scheduled at 03:00 UTC. alex, please trigger and monitor.
alex: Executing full unpin now.
deploy-bot: UNPIN completed: sdk v3.1 -> v3.2 rolled out (full). Summary: staged canary -> full; no regressions detected during monitoring window.
alex: Closing thread. Nice collaboration. :tada:
